senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Bilgah, chief of a priests’ division; whence, fem. (sub. משפחת) name of a priests’ division, v. מִשְׁמָר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:8">Succ. V, 8</cite> <he>ב׳ לעולם וכ׳</he> the Bilgah division at all times distributes its shares of the show-bread in the Southern part of the Temple courts.
<cite ref="Sukkah 56b:7">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:28">Tosef. ib. IV, 28</cite> <cite ref="B00613"><he>בִּילְגָּא</he></cite> ed. Zuck.
